original_ai_output.title_zh: 拉各斯两辆集装箱卡车侧翻，致一对母子死亡
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚拉各斯州Mile 2地区Freeman Market附近，两辆载有20英尺集装箱的卡车侧翻，一对母子被压在车下身亡。拉各斯州交通管理局（LASTMA）公共关系与宣传部主任Adebayo Taofiq在周日声明中披露此事。目前该事件为单一来源报道。

location.raw_text: Mile 2, by Freeman Market, inward Apapa, Lagos State

key_facts.fact: 两辆载有20英尺集装箱的卡车在拉各斯Mile 2侧翻
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: two trucks, laden with 20ft containers, overturned at Mile 2, by Freeman Market, inward Apapa, Lagos State

key_facts.fact: 一对母子在事故中死亡，被压在侧翻卡车及集装箱下
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the victims were trapped beneath the overturned trucks and their containers, sustaining fatal injuries in the incident

key_facts.fact: LASTMA官员Adebayo Taofiq在周日声明中披露此事
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Director of Public Affairs and Enlightenment Department of LASTMA, Adebayo Taofiq, disclosed this in a statement on Sunday

uncertainties: 事件目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
事故具体原因尚未说明
